independent_tests.test_output_summary: Independent test verification skipped (tests not required for testing tasks)

criteria_results.evidence: Implemented comprehensive parametrized tests covering path-traversal (../../../etc/passwd), SQL injection ('; DROP TABLE runbooks; --), JNDI injection (${jndi:ldap://evil}), null-byte injection (dynamically constructed chr(0)), backtick command injection (`rm -rf /`), unicode characters, and percent-encoded payloads. All adversarial strings round-trip byte-identical through create→load as verified by TestAdversarialIdentifiersRoundTrip with 7 passing test cases.

Implemented TestAdversarialParamsRoundTrip with two test methods: test_params_with_newline_tab_quote_nested_mapping_round_trip covering newlines, tabs, single quotes, double quotes, nested mappings, unicode, backslashes, and JSON characters; and test_params_with_sql_injection_payloads_round_trip covering SQL injection payloads in params. Both tests verify params reload identical via equality assertion.

criteria_results.criterion_text: A 1,000,000-char `captured_output` reloads with the same length and
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented TestLargeCapturedOutputRoundTrip.test_one_million_char_output_reloads_intact that constructs a 1,000,000-character string with a recognizable repeating pattern (0123456789 × 100 × 1000), persists it as StepResult.captured_output, and verifies: (1) length equals 1,000,000, (2) full string equality, (3) pattern integrity at start, middle (500,000), and end positions.

criteria_results.criterion_text: A status update refused mid-write (simulated store-unavailable)
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented TestStatusUpdateRollbackAtomicity.test_status_update_failure_preserves_prior_status that: (1) creates a runbook with pending status, (2) updates to running status and commits, (3) simulates store unavailability by creating a repository with a closed connection, (4) attempts update with the broken repository (fails with ProgrammingError), (5) reloads with original repository and verifies status remains running, demonstrating rollback atomicity.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Re-applying `runbook.apply()` to a populated, already-migrated store
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented TestMigrationIdempotence with two test methods: test_reapplying_migration_preserves_existing_data creates a runbook with 2 steps, re-applies the migration, and verifies all runbook and step fields remain identical (runbook_id, target, current_step_index, status, created_at, all step fields); test_reapplying_migration_multiple_times_is_safe applies the migration 5 consecutive times and verifies data integrity, demonstrating idempotent migration behavior.

All tests are implemented in tests/forge/persistence/test_runbook_security.py (single file). The writer_db fixture uses tmp_path to create a fresh SQLite database, applies lifecycle migrations and runbook migration, and yields the connection. All test classes use this fixture pattern. Coach validation command 'python -m pytest tests/forge/persistence/test_runbook_security.py -q' executed successfully with 13 passed tests in 0.08s.
